### Figure 2C Celltype logfc enrichment (relapse+/-)

```{r}
p <- annots %>%
  left_join(mdata[, c('Patient', 'Relapse')]) %>%
  group_by(path, cellType, Relapse) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(cellType, Relapse) %>%
  summarise(mean_n = mean(n), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Relapse, values_from = mean_n) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(cellType), names_to = 'Relapse', values_to = 'n') %>%
  group_by(cellType) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total_n = sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(diff = log2((n/total_n) / (first(n)/first(total_n)))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Relapse == 'N') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(cellType, diff), y = diff, fill = cellType)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = 'darkorange2', alpha = 0.02) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymax = 0), fill = 'lightsteelblue', alpha = 0.02) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = annot_palette, guide = 'none') +
    annotate('text', x = 4, y = 0.9, label = 'Relapse+', size = 10) +
    annotate('text', x = 13, y = -0.9, label = 'Relapse-', size = 10) +
    labs(x = 'Cell Type', y = 'Log2 Fold Enrichment', title = 'Cell Type Enrichment (Relapse+/Relapse-)') + 
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
          axis.title.x = element_blank())

ggsave('Figure2C.pdf', p, device = 'pdf', width = 6, height = 4)

# significance
celltype_proportions <- annots %>%
  left_join(mdata[, c('Patient', 'Relapse')]) %>%
  group_by(PointNum, Relapse) %>%
  mutate(total_cells = n()) %>%
  group_by(PointNum, cellType, Relapse, total_cells) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    proportion = count / total_cells,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

wilcox_results <- celltype_proportions %>%
  group_by(cellType) %>%
  do(test = wilcox.test(proportion ~ Relapse, data = .)) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = test$p.value,
    p_text = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(cellType, p_value, p_text)

print(wilcox_results)

```

### Figure 2D cell type frequency by patient

```{r}
# infiltration
p <- annots %>% 
  group_by(PointNum, Patient, cellType) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(PointNum, Patient) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(mdata[, c('Patient', 'Relapse')]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder_within(PointNum, freq, cellType), y = freq, fill = Relapse)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = relapse_palette, guide = 'none') +
  facet_wrap(~cellType, scales = 'free', ncol = 8) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 3),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6))

ggsave('Figure2D.pdf', p, device = 'pdf', width = 12, height = 4)
```
